faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Have questions? Find your answers right here.
faq.1q: Is there a fee for the card?
faq.1a: No. Registration and issuing the card are completely free.
faq.2a: You earn 1 coin for every 1,000 UZS spent.
faq.3q: Where can I use the 50,000 UZS discount bonus?
faq.3a: This discount is awarded upon installation and can be used at Husma Hotel, Husma Fit, and Mavi Restaurant.
faq.4q: How do tier levels (Bronze, Silver...) increase?
faq.4a: You automatically reach higher levels as you collect coins (e.g., Bronze at 99,000 coins, VIP tier at 999,000 coins).
